name: get_sandbox_info
title: Get sandbox information
description:
Describe the user's sandbox for this environment: its title and description, installed Python packages and
versions, CPUs, memory, free disk, running jobs, limits, files in /workspace, and how long the sandbox has been up.
Call it before the first execute_code of a task: the sandbox is shared by the user's conversations and may hold
files from earlier work. Call it again if files you created are missing: a sandbox that was stopped after being
idle comes back empty, with a new sandbox_instance.

name: execute_code
title: Execute code
description: Run Python or bash code in the sandbox and return status, exit_code, stdout and stderr. Python runs in the environment's own virtual environment, which has only that environment's packages (get_sandbox_info lists them); packages cannot be installed. Each call is a new process: no variables survive between calls, so write intermediate results to files under /workspace (in a directory named for the task, since other conversations share the sandbox) and read them back in later calls. Save figures and images to files. The sandbox has no internet access: code cannot download data, call web APIs or fetch example datasets, so pass inputs with write_file. Use background=true for work longer than about a minute, then poll get_job.

code.description: Source code to run, up to 262144 characters.
code.title: Code

timeout_seconds.description: Seconds to wait before the process is killed, 1 to 600 (default 300). Ignored with background=true.
timeout_seconds.title: Timeout Seconds

background.description: Start the process and return a job_id at once; poll it with get_job.
background.title: Background

max_output_bytes.description: Maximum bytes of stdout and of stderr to return (the tail), 1 to 262144.
max_output_bytes.title: Max Output Bytes

name: get_job
title: Get job
description:
Get the status, exit_code and output tail of a job started by execute_code, optionally waiting for it to
finish. Without job_id, list the jobs in this sandbox.

job_id.description: Job ID from execute_code. Omit it to list all jobs in this sandbox.
job_id.title: Job Id

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the job to finish before returning, 0 to 600.
wait_seconds.title: Wait Seconds

max_output_bytes.description: Maximum bytes of stdout and of stderr to return (the tail), 1 to 262144.
max_output_bytes.title: Max Output Bytes

name: cancel_job
title: Cancel job
description: Kill a running job and its child processes and return its final status and output tail.

name: read_file
title: Read file
description:
Read a file from the sandbox, up to 1 MiB per call (use offset to page through larger files). Use
encoding=base64 for binary files such as PNG images.

path.description: Path in the sandbox: absolute, or relative to /workspace.
path.title: Path

encoding.description: text (UTF-8, default) or base64 for binary files.
encoding.title: Encoding

offset.description: Byte offset to start reading from (default 0).
offset.title: Offset

name: write_file
title: Write file
description:
Write a file into the sandbox (for example input data such as CSV, TSV, SMILES, SDF or VCF text), creating
parent directories. Overwrites an existing file unless append=true.

path.description: Path in the sandbox: absolute, or relative to /workspace.
path.title: Path

content.description: File content, up to 1048576 characters: text, or base64 with encoding=base64.
content.title: Content

name: list_files
title: List files
description: List the files in a sandbox directory with their type and size.
